notes: This contract pins Umbra's bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 connection and callback-control foundation to the exact official C++ RTIambassador declarations exported by the Requirements Lab. It traces all four Connect overloads, Disconnect, both Evoke variants, and Enable/Disable Callbacks to real Catch2 scenarios. The embedded profile accepts the official Credentials object as opaque and does not implement authentication, exposes only its documented filesystem service-report-directory setting, and has no remote endpoint. The Requirements Lab's aggregate Connect mapping remains ambiguous; this API-only contract records the individual declaration records without treating that ambiguity as resolved. It is not catalog, JUnit, protected-review, package, interoperability, or conformance evidence.
